surfaces.label: Embedded raster image decoding and page raster allocation
surfaces.notes: Rejected unbounded-single-image hypothesis: Cargo.lock:1307-1308 selects image 0.25.10; inspected local dependency images/dynimage.rs:1676-1679 constructs ImageReader with default Limits; io/limits.rs:47-55 defaults max_alloc to 512MiB; io/image_reader_type.rs:314-320 reserves decoder.total_bytes() and sets limits before DynamicImage allocation. src/convert/raster.rs:26,39 caps page pixels; src/markdown/from_docx/media.rs:13,94 caps extraction headers at 50M pixels. These do not prove an aggregate document memory budget; high-but-bounded amplification and decoder internals remain a limitation rather than an established separate exploit.

candidate.title: Potential image decompression resource amplification
candidate.question: Does package admission or the decoder enforce decoded pixel/allocation limits, and do retained decoded images allow attacker-amplified memory use?

candidate.title: Attacker-controlled DOCX/HTML table spans allocate unbounded columns
evidence: src/convert/mod.rs:14212-14217 cell_span parses gridSpan as usize, only .max(1); table_block:13466 uses it; 13599-13615 sums spans into occupancy then vec![each; occupancy] or cols.resize(occupancy.max(1),80.0). gridSpan=2147483647 requests about 8GiB; usize::MAX causes capacity overflow.
src/convert/mod.rs:14340-14346 row_grid_skip parses gridBefore/gridAfter usize without cap.
src/convert/altchunk.rs:562-567 parses colspan usize without cap; 477-482 sums columns; 500-502 loops 0..cols generating WML. colspan=2147483647 generates tens of GiB.
src/convert/mod.rs:591 render -> with_layout:769-806 admits then parses; :792-799 altchunk expansion occurs after admission.
candidate.counterevidence: Package/XML byte/depth budgets exist but do not inspect these semantic numeric values; no execution performed.

candidate.title: Unbounded numbering levels drive billion-iteration scans or counter allocation
evidence: src/convert/mod.rs:12711-12715 num_pr parses paragraph ilvl as u32 without upper bound.
src/convert/mod.rs:5518-5532 resolve_ilvl scans (0..ilvl).rev() for existing parent; ilvl=4294967295 with only level 0 requires billions of hash lookups.
src/convert/mod.rs:5610-5627 next_marker inserts counters for each 0..resolved when matching huge abstract level exists.
candidate.counterevidence: Admission is prior to conversion but does not constrain numeric ilvl; public render is input boundary. No application execution performed.

candidate.title: Quadratic entity rescan through decoded relationship targets
evidence: src/xmllinq/parse.rs:764-789 each literal ampersand scans remaining suffix for semicolon then advances one char.
quick-xml 0.42 slice_reader.rs:318 and mod.rs:327/335 rejects dangling ampersands, so raw repeated ampersands do not pass admission.
Legitimate relationship Target containing repeated & passes XML gate; oxml-opc 0.14.2/src/relationship.rs:932 decoded_and_normalized_value returns literal ampersands.
src/opc/mod.rs:693-696 PartFs::resolve_rel_target invokes unescape_xml_text on decoded target; src/inspect.rs:775 and src/comparer.rs:4730-4731 use parsed rel.target.
